download_single_example: download a single interaction example from S3 with auto-sampling or a specific file ID
download_interaction_pair: download a pair of interactions from the same session with auto-sampling or a specific interaction key
download_samples_1gb: download approximately 1GB of diverse interaction samples from S3 with auto-sampling or specific file IDs
download_session_exploration: download a complete session group of interactions from S3 with auto-sampling or a specific session key
run_download_s3_main: run the main entry point to display S3 download options with intelligent sampling
